desc:
Welcome to Midnight Motel🛒
Leave a LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ for more!

You're staying at a local motel for the night, where rumors are circulating about mysterious killings. Try to uncover the mysterious killer and find out who it is!

There are 4 endings! Try to get them all!
🤝 This game is multiplayer and can be played by up to 8 players at once!
This game may be slightly difficult to new players, playing with friends or other people is recommended.
🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with!

Credits:
Devutay --> Scripting
CrowShade --> Music

⭐ Inspired by the Nightshift Experience and RCM Games.
